text:
natalie.product: Quick update — prefetch-v2 rollout is complete and we've flipped the global routing. Early results look very positive :tada: p50 latency down from ~45ms to ~28ms (~38% drop), p99 down from ~220ms to ~150ms (~32% drop), throughput up ~2.3x, and estimated token cost reduction ~18%. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example.com/prefetch-v2

sam.runtime: Awesome — what percentage was the canary and when did you flip it?

natalie.product: Canary was 20% last night for ~6 hours, no regressions observed. We flipped to 100% at 02:15 UTC. Key changes: smarter KV-prefetch heuristics + coalescer tuning + small TTL tweak for hot prefixes.

lee.eng: Bench note — reproduced on perf rig with 50 concurrency:```bash
ab -n 10000 -c 50 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"``` p50 ~28ms on prefetch-v2 vs ~47ms on v1. Logs and run script in /perf/runs/prefetch-v2-2026-03-22.

tariq.sre: Observability check — traces show fewer blocking waits in the cache hot path. I've added an alert: p99 increase >10% vs baseline for 30m -> pager to oncall. Oncall contact: @tariq.sre. No error-rate spike so far.

maria.ops: Cost ops FYI — rough forecast points to ~$35k/mo savings at current traffic. I'll update the next billing sync and the cost dashboard.

deploy-bot: deploy finished by natalie.product at 02:15 UTC — changelog: prefetch-v2 rollout, kv-ttl-adjust, coalescer-tuning. CI: green, smoke tests: passed.

sam.runtime: Rollback plan if something odd shows up?

natalie.product: Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% or sustained p99 regression >15% for 30m. If triggered we revert routing to prefetch-v1 and open follow-up PR (#894) for fixes.

alex.research: Nice! Any customer-facing impact or opt-in required?

natalie.product: No API surface change. It's a runtime variant flip only. We can route specific customers back to v1 via a routing policy: `route.model_variant="prefetch-v1"` if needed.

lee.eng: TL;DR: lower latency, better throughput, less cost, safe rollback. Great work team :rocket:
